title: Springfield Women in Tech Holiday Party
seo_title: Springfield Women in Tech Holiday Party at Village Meeple
description: A holiday party hosted by Springfield Women in Technology to celebrate the group's year, with dinner, dessert, and unlimited play from the board game library at Village Meeple, a board game cafe. Admission is free, drinks are available for purchase, Pro Members get 2 free drink tickets, and family members are welcome to come along. It takes place Tuesday, December 15, 2026, from 5:30 to 8:30 PM at 1570 E Battlefield Rd in Springfield, Missouri.
